    <div class="uni-page uni-grid">
  <section
    id="available"
    aria-label="Gemini 4 Carbon is available"
    class="
      uni-article-jumplinks__section
      uni-grid__col--layout-6
      
      "

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Gemini 4 Carbon is now available"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="3tdy4">Today, we’re making Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers. Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows across complex knowledge work, software engineering, and scientific reasoning.</p><p data-block-key="cpmug"><a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-carbon/">Two weeks ago</a>, we released Carbon to a set of cybersecurity defenders via our <a href="https://deepmind.google/fairwind-program/">Fairwind Program</a>. Following our recent launch of <a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-argon/">Gemini 4 Argon</a>, Carbon pushes the frontier even further. Argon remains the ideal choice for the majority of software engineering and knowledge work, while Carbon is built for tasks that test the limits of a model’s intelligence like complex, multi-step coding and debugging and open-ended scientific research and discovery — using more tokens than Argon to explore thoroughly, reason deeply, and run extended verification loops.</p><p data-block-key="cgo05">Across independent benchmarks designed to test model performance in real workflows, Carbon pairs frontier accuracy with practical production economics. It ranks #1 on <a href="https://cursor.com/cursorbench">CursorBench 4.0</a>, <a href="https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/wandr-benchmark-evaluating-research-agents-that-must-search-wide-and-deep">Perplexity’s WANDR</a>, and <a href="https://zapier.com/benchmarks">Zapier’s AutomationBench</a> at more than 2X lower cost per task compared to the next best external model.</p><p data-block-key="7bsh2">To put Carbon’s capabilities to work on larger and complex projects, we’re <a href="http://antigravity.google/blog/gemini-4-carbon-in-google-antigravity/">previewing</a> <code>/swarm</code> in Google Antigravity, turning a single prompt into a coordinated team of agents you can track in real time. Developers can assign Carbon to roles that demand the deepest reasoning, like architectural design, coordination, and auditing, while pairing it with faster, lighter models across parallel isolated workspaces and adversarial verifiers that test every change.</p><p data-block-key="bj3k4">Gemini 4 Carbon is available via the API in <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/prompts/new_chat?model=gemini-4-carbon">Google AI Studio</a> and <a href="https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise">Gemini for business</a> for all paying developers and enterprises, at the same <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing">introductory price</a>

<a class="superscript"
    data-ga4-analytics-superscript-click
    data-tooltip-content-id="footnote-content-1"
    data-target="inline text"
    href="#footnote-1"
    id="footnote-source-1"
    aria-label="Jump to link reference 1"><sup>1</sup></a>
 as Gemini 4 Argon ($2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens). It is also rolling out to all <a href="https://one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans">Google AI Ultra subscribers</a> in <a href="https://antigravity.google/">Google Antigravity</a>, the <a href="http://gemini.google.com/">Gemini app</a>, and <a href="http://aimode.google/">AI Mode in Search</a>.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

  

  
    <div class="uni-page uni-grid">
  <section
    id="higher-precision"
    aria-label="Higher-precision knowledge work"
    class="
      uni-article-jumplinks__section
      uni-grid__col--layout-6
      
      "
    
    tabindex="-1">
    
  </section>
</div>

  

  
    

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Gemini 4 Carbon is now available"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="3tdy4">Higher-precision knowledge work, artifact generation, and data analysis</h2><p data-block-key="3kas3">Across legal, finance, and enterprise operations, Gemini 4 Carbon combines frontier visual understanding, reasoning, and exhaustive retrieval to synthesize grounded insights across large sets of dense documents and data. It follows strict schemas and formatting to generate polished and precise spreadsheets, presentations, and reports.</p><p data-block-key="54n09">Existing benchmarks don’t adequately capture how agents reason natively over dense files with charts, images, blueprints, schematics, and tables, so we partnered with Artificial Analysis to launch the new <a href="https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/mka">Multimodal Knowledge Agent</a> (MKA) benchmark that tests a model’s multimodal performance in agentic workflows. Carbon ranks #2 while being more than 6X lower in average cost per task compared to the top performing model.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

    <div class="uni-page uni-grid">
  <section
    id="state-of-the-art-cybersecurity"
    aria-label="State-of-the-art cybersecurity"
    class="
      uni-article-jumplinks__section

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Gemini 4 Carbon is now available"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="5bbt2">Frontier cybersecurity capabilities</h2><p data-block-key="1uh8m">Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber delivers our strongest cybersecurity capabilities to date, giving security teams the end-to-end intelligence they need in protecting critical software. When accessed through the Fairwind Program, Carbon leads on key benchmarks across finding (SEC-bench Pro), exploiting (ExploitGym), and patching (CWE-bench v1) vulnerabilities: inspecting software, tracing how flaws can be chained together across systems, and generating verified root-cause patches.</p><p data-block-key="9t6tk">Early testers inside and outside of Google are already seeing strong results with Carbon for cyber in practice.</p><ul><li data-block-key="bd001"><a href="https://cloud.google.com/transform/how-google-does-it-using-agents-help-find-track-and-fix-vulnerabilities">In Project Fortify</a>, Google’s autonomous system spanning scanning, triage, and remediation, Carbon hit 100% recall on scanning and 95% precision on triage, on our internal benchmark. On Open Source code repository testing we see an over 25% relative improvement on Argon's already strong recall rate, surfacing previously undetected, real-world logic flaws. Bringing these gains across Google, one of the world’s largest users of open-source software, helps secure both our own systems and the broader ecosystem.</li><li data-block-key="215jt">Google’s Cloud Vulnerability Research (CVR) team recently used Carbon to prove that two bugs in a popular open-source software were in fact exploitable vulnerabilities, comparable in severity to the recent <a href="https://www.wiz.io/blog/php2shell-php-rce">PHP2Shell exploit</a>. By using Carbon to build a proof of concept, CVR helped maintainers re-classify the bug as critical and swiftly issue a patch. Details will be shared after the responsible disclosure process completes.</li><li data-block-key="13scv">As part of Wiz’s<a href="https://www.wiz.io/blog/scan-for-good-critical-ai-exposures"> Scan for Good</a> program, the team used Carbon to assess vulnerabilities in public digital infrastructure. For example, when scanning two major SaaS providers, the model uncovered 0-day vulnerabilities in under two hours compressing weeks of vulnerability research to a single afternoon. The team partnered with the impacted organizations to remediate in record time, helping to mitigate potential impact on tens of thousands of companies.</li></ul></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

    <div class="uni-page uni-grid">
  <section
    id="frontier-level-scientific-reasoning"
    aria-label="Frontier-level scientific reasoning"
    class="
      uni-article-jumplinks__section
      uni-grid__col--layout-6
      
      "
    
    tabindex="-1">

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Gemini 4 Carbon is now available"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="5bbt2">Stronger scientific and mathematical reasoning</h2><p data-block-key="460ur">Gemini 4 Carbon shows strongly improved performance in reasoning across physics, math, and life sciences, synthesizing experimental data, testing hypotheses, and reasoning through multi-step domain problems. For drug toxicity research company Axiom Bio, Carbon is now the leading model in performance for translational science, finding novel mechanisms of toxicity they hadn’t found previously. Axiom is now moving their production scientific analyses and agents to both Carbon and Argon to unlock the creation of safer drugs.</p><p data-block-key="98cq5">Researchers across Google have been using Carbon in Google Antigravity to accelerate their work:</p><ul><li data-block-key="4lh5g"><b>Code verification:</b> Researchers built a new agentic framework for formal verification called AlphaProof Code and put it to work on a major security challenge:<a href="https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-alphaproof-code"> mathematically proving the actual code underlying the cryptographic protocol of Signal</a>. Using Carbon alongside other models, our researchers translated security goals to mathematical theorems. AlphaProof Code agents then used Carbon to generate millions of lines of code in Lean, a computer language for writing mathematical proofs, helping them prove key security properties in weeks — a task that historically takes expert teams years. The result indicates Carbon’s potential to unlock scalable formal verification, long considered a gold-standard approach to building secure software.</li><li data-block-key="685k2"><b>Enzyme assay development</b>: Provided with only lab notebooks and raw data, Carbon went beyond standard analysis to surface hard-to-interpret data anomalies, which it used to diagnose subtle wet lab experimental artifacts such as incomplete automated mixing in deep wells, leading to substantially improved reproducibility. Moreover Carbon improved methods to deconvolute chromatography peaks and caught trace sample carryover in research instruments, significantly accelerating the development of new assays and tightening the feedback loop between computation and the bench.</li><li data-block-key="e0ntl"><b>Protein structure prediction:</b> Structure prediction models like AlphaFold 3 use Multiple Sequence Alignments (MSAs) of evolutionary relatives to help infer how amino acid chains fold. As a result they often struggle on understudied, viral, microbial, and eukaryotic proteins that have very few matches in standard databases. Working in a multi-agent setup, our researchers used Gemini 4 Carbon to autonomously discover remote homologs across petabase-scale unannotated sequence archives, environmental and viral sequence catalogs, and 3D structure databases. For example, across 7 low-homolog protein families from the CASP17 blind test set, Carbon increased the number of homologs retrieved by 40-fold on average, greatly increasing the information available to structure prediction models without need for retraining. While broader benchmarking is still underway, addressing this upstream search bottleneck potentially offers a promising path toward modeling hard-to-characterize regions of the proteome.</li></ul><p data-block-key="48uh0">Four weeks ago, we opened applications to give 10,000 scientists access to Argon in Google Antigravity free of charge for six months to accelerate the pace of their research, and we’ve onboarded thousands of scientists already. Today, we’re expanding access to Carbon for current and future participants, and going forward, the program will continue providing access to our latest frontier models as they become available. <a href="https://forms.gle/WvmBbPvRbpKG1BPn9">Applications remain open</a> and onboarding continues on a weekly rolling basis, subject to eligibility, capacity, and selection.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

  

  
    <div class="uni-page uni-grid">
  <section
    id="safety-security"
    aria-label="Progress in model safety and security"
    class="
      uni-article-jumplinks__section
      uni-grid__col--layout-6
      
      "
    
    tabindex="-1">
    
  </section>
</div>

  

  
    

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Gemini 4 Carbon is now available"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="5bbt2">Progress in model safety and security</h2><p data-block-key="68gi7">With each new model release, we continue to strengthen our safety and security mitigations, agentic misuse prevention, model alignment, and harm reduction proportionately with model capability.</p><p data-block-key="afn3q">Because Gemini 4 Carbon introduces stronger cyber capabilities we build on Argon’s <a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/safety-security/gemini-4-model-safety-security/">strong safety and security stack</a> to fortify robustness to misuse and prompt injection.</p><ul><li data-block-key="ee2d3"><b>Mitigating frontier safety misuse risks:</b> We’ve strengthened our misuse safeguards to help ensure stronger defensive reasoning does not translate into offensive risk. In simulated cyberattack testing environments seeded with ExploitBench and CyScenarioBench, Carbon blocked 99% of attack trajectories from our adaptive red-teaming agent that can iteratively revisit its attack plans after each block. The Carbon safeguards lowered the per-attempt breach rate to just 0.8% (down from 3.1% on Argon). Our safeguards also lowered the automated cyberattack query success rate to 2.17% in Gray Swan’s testing, compared to 9.86% on Argon. And external testing by Trajectory Labs found zero new universal jailbreaks across 132 hours and over 13,000 requests.</li><li data-block-key="dfkn4"><b>Promoting safe and aligned model interactions:</b> When we announced Carbon, we showed significant improvements in alignment as measured by our monitor flag rates across the model’s lifecycle, as well as reductions in data fabrication. New results show that on our 375-task agentic honesty benchmark, it passed 92% of tasks (compared to 70% for Argon) — declining to fill in missing experimental data 98% of the time and flagging methodological flaws 68% of the time.</li></ul></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Gemini 4 Carbon is now available"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><ul><li data-block-key="5hajt"><b>Protecting users from indirect prompt injection attacks:</b> Two weeks ago, we shared that Carbon achieved a 0% prompt injection attack success rate on the Gray Swan IPI benchmark — marking the first time that milestone has been reached. At the same time, we know that prompt injection robustness remains an area for continued improvement. Our advanced automated red teaming continues to push the limits here and has shown that models could be further improved against sophisticated attacks in some distributions. It provides the data for us to continuously advance our models’ security to the next frontier.</li></ul><p data-block-key="4cti3">For more details, read the full <a href="https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/gemini/gemini_4_carbon_safety_report.pdf">Gemini 4 Carbon Safety and Security report</a>.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

  <section

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Gemini 4 Carbon is now available"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="5hajt">Getting started with Gemini 4 Carbon</h2><p data-block-key="ejvnp">Starting today, Carbon joins Argon in our family of frontier models across our products:</p><ul><li data-block-key="6d6ho"><b>For developers:</b> Build with the Gemini API paid tier in <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/prompts/new_chat?model=gemini-4-carbon">AI Studio</a> and <a href="https://developer.android.com/studio">Android Studio</a>, and if you’re a Google AI Ultra subscriber, you can try it in <a href="https://antigravity.google/">Google Antigravity</a> and AI Studio.</li><li data-block-key="duemm"><b>For enterprises:</b> Try it in <a href="https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise">Gemini for business</a> via the API or model drop down, Google Antigravity, or CodeMender.</li><li data-block-key="avih5"><b>For everyday users:</b> Try Carbon starting today in the <a href="http://gemini.google.com">Gemini app</a> and <a href="http://aimode.google/">AI Mode in Search</a> if you’re a Google AI Ultra subscriber.</li><li data-block-key="as12f"><b>For scientists &amp; researchers:</b> <a href="https://forms.gle/WvmBbPvRbpKG1BPn9">Apply</a> for a chance to get access to both Argon and Carbon via Google Antigravity’s highest usage tier free of charge for 6 months (onboarded on a rolling basis), subject to eligibility, capacity, and selection.</li><li data-block-key="8u2rt"><b>For cybersecurity defenders:</b> Apply to join the <a href="https://deepmind.google/fairwind-program/">Fairwind Program</a> to get access to Carbon for cyber on a rolling basis.</li></ul><p data-block-key="bbnh">See the <a href="https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/Model-Cards/Gemini-4-Carbon-Model-Card.pdf">model card</a> to learn more about Gemini 4 Carbon and to start building with it, explore our updated Gemini 4 <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/learn/gemini-4-carbon-developer-guide">developer guide</a> and <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/docs/whats-new-gemini-4-carbon">documentation</a> for best practices on migrating workflows to the model.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>
